top_signals.title: Indian IT Stocks Set for Best Day in 17 Months On AI Selloff
top_signals.summary: India’s software services stocks are headed for their biggest jump in 17 months as a slide in Asian chipmakers triggered a rotation into the so-called anti-artificial intelligence trade.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Chinese Refiners to Slow Inventory Drawdowns as Imports Pick Up
top_signals.summary: Chinese refiners will slow drawdowns of oil from reserves this month as crude imports recover, according to Energy Aspects.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Once-Crowded Dutch Pensions Trade Can Make a Comeback, BNP Says
top_signals.summary: Appetite for a popular, but ultimately disappointing rates bet on the overhaul of the €1.7 trillion ($1.9 trillion) Dutch pension industry is returning, according to BNP Paribas SA.
